Synopsis:
    Brent crude is approaching $100/bbl driven by escalating Middle East conflict (Iranian strikes on US assets, Houthi attacks on Saudi cities), weighing on risk appetite. Asian equities are mixed, with AI-linked stocks outperforming. The yen is strengthening sharply against the dollar on hawkish BOJ expectations, defying the usual oil-driven depreciation logic. Key near-term catalysts include ECB rate decision (Thursday), US PPI/CPI data, UK GDP, and the upcoming Fed and BoE decisions the following week.
